company.description: Ishto is a UAE-based B2B social networking and trade platform designed for wholesalers, importers, exporters, distributors, and small business owners. The platform combines elements of a social network, marketplace, and business community to help users discover suppliers and buyers, promote products, participate in virtual exhibitions, and build professional trade connections.
